notes.title: Soft Release Date
notes.notes:
June 20 is the projected release date, but may change depending on circumstances.

Just this week we've acquired some more music for the game and I have completed some of the final art. I expect we'll have all art assets completed and finalized by the end of the month!

Thank you all for the feedback and support you've given me on this journey making my first game!

https://www.youtube.com/c/PsychorGames
